notes: The marginal note 'Or, the state' at mədînâ was read and set aside (rule 38).

'the violent taking away' was read as one substantive's multi-word rendering headed on 'taking' (rule 31); 'violent' as the competing head is possible but 'taking' is the word whose loss loses the lexeme.
mēʿal is a compound of two prepositions rendered by one comparative word, so it heads on the governing opening morpheme (rule 23).
